relations.name: source_invoice
relations.meaning: An invoice record exactly as represented in billing sources, keyed by source invoice_id.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/billing/invoices.json by invoice_id; field values copied verbatim from the matching object.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one referent per invoices.json element; assert one tuple per invoice with all scalar fields from that object.

relations.name: source_crm_account
relations.meaning: A CRM account row exactly as represented in CRM sources, keyed by crm_account_id.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id row; field values copied verbatim.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one referent per CRM row; assert one tuple per account with all scalar fields from that row.

relations.name: source_registry_company
relations.meaning: A company registry row exactly as represented in the registry source, keyed by company_number.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/company_registry.csv by company_number row; field values copied verbatim.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one referent per registry row; assert one tuple per company with all scalar fields from that row.

relations.name: source_contract
relations.meaning: Contract document metadata and counterparty name as stated in the contract header, keyed by contract filename stem.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/contracts/<contract_id>.md header fields; contract_id is filename without .md; empty expiry_date when not stated.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse each contract markdown file for header counterparty, effective date, term line, and explicit expiry if present; document_kind from title (MSA, SOW, etc.).

relations.name: contract_clause_excerpt
relations.meaning: Verbatim excerpt of a numbered or titled clause section from a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to the specific heading and body span in sources/contracts/<contract_id>.md.
relations.construction_rule: C1: split contract markdown on section headings; emit one tuple per clause section with heading text and following paragraph text.

relations.name: legal_name_normalization
relations.meaning: Mechanical normalization of unambiguous legal-form variants of the same registered name (e.g., Ltd versus Limited, Inc. versus Incorporated).
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded as a deterministic transform rule applied to a source name string; no external judgment.
relations.construction_rule: C1: apply fixed legal-suffix and punctuation normalization rules to names appearing in CRM, billing, registry, and contract headers; emit only when the transform is unambiguous.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate one candidate per distinct name string observed in source_invoice.billed_name, source_crm_account.account_name, source_registry_company.legal_name, and source_contract.counterparty_name_as_stated.

relations.name: contract_lifecycle_status
relations.meaning: Whether a contract is currently active or expired based on stated effective dates, expiry dates, and term mechanics in sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each disposition grounded to source_contract dates/term_text and any explicit non-renewal or expiry statements in the contract file or authoritative notes under sources/.
relations.construction_rule: C2: for each source_contract referent, judge active versus expired from dates and term language; an expired statement of work is EXPIRED.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent in source_contract.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract remains in force on the evaluation date given term mechanics, explicit expiry, and renewal language.

relations.name: contract_term_reading
relations.meaning: Factual reading of whether a contract contains a specified clause family or obligation kind in its text.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to contract_clause_excerpt spans (and header term_text where applicable) that support or fail to support the reading.
relations.construction_rule: C2: read contract text for each term_kind independently; do not collapse into acquisition-relevance or dependency classifications.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each contract referent, emit one candidate per term_kind in {change_of_control_consent_required, termination_on_change_of_control, assignment_consent_or_notice_required, assignment_affiliate_only, assignment_competitor_prohibited, exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether contract language clearly asserts the named term_kind is present or absent.

relations.name: legal_entity_identity
relations.meaning: Whether two source-native commercial records refer to the same legal counterparty, a distinct legal counterparty, or cannot be confidently decided.
relations.grounding_contract: Each disposition grounded to matching legal names, registry numbers, tax identifiers, contract counterparty statements, and authoritative notes under sources/; superficial name similarity alone is insufficient for SAME_ENTITY.
relations.construction_rule: C2: judge pairwise identity across CRM accounts, billed names, registry companies, and contract counterparties; permit UNRESOLVED rather than inferring DISTINCT from missing evidence.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Enumerate undirected pairs required to connect each commercially relevant CRM account to its billed name, governing contract referent, and each registry row that is a plausible legal-entity candidate for that relationship (per commercial_notes and name overlap heuristics only as pair generation, not as disposition).
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two records denote the same legal entity versus distinct entities.

relations.name: invoice_contract_link
relations.meaning: Whether a billed invoice is governed by a specific contract based on counterparty identity and authoritative relationship evidence in sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each disposition grounded to billed_name, contract counterparty_name_as_stated, legal_entity_identity chains, and explicit relationship statements in authoritative sources under sources/.
relations.construction_rule: C2: judge invoice-to-contract linkage from identity and stated commercial relationships; missing identity yields UNRESOLVED, not a negative link.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate (invoice, contract) pairs where billed_name or CRM-linked identity plausibly relates to the contract counterparty name or where authoritative notes name the pairing.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the invoice revenue is tied to the named contract counterparty relationship.

relations.name: invoice_open
relations.meaning: Whether an invoice is open versus closed or paid as recorded in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from source_invoice.status with SOURCE grounding to the invoice row.
relations.construction_rule: C4: is_open true when source_invoice.status equals 'open'; false otherwise.

relations.name: active_contract
relations.meaning: Contracts whose lifecycle status is ACTIVE.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from contract_lifecycle_status with disposition ACTIVE.
relations.construction_rule: C4: select contract referents where contract_lifecycle_status.disposition = 'ACTIVE'.

relations.name: counterparty_identifier
relations.meaning: Canonical purpose-B identifier string for a source-native record (crm:, billing:, registry:, or contract: prefix forms).
relations.grounding_contract: Derived deterministically from source-native keys in source_crm_account, source_invoice billed_name, source_registry_company, and source_contract.
relations.construction_rule: C4: map CRM accounts to crm:<crm_account_id>, invoices to billing:<billed_name>, registry rows to registry:<company_number>, contracts to contract:<contract_id>.

relations.name: purpose_a_qualifying_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoices in scope for purpose A with acquisition-relevant exposure labeling and association asserted versus unresolved per purpose policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from source_invoice, invoice_contract_link, active_contract, and contract_term_reading rows for acquisition-relevant term_kinds; association label applies purpose confidence threshold to invoice_contract_link.
relations.construction_rule: C4: include invoice when linked (or link-unresolved) to an active contract whose term readings satisfy purpose A acquisition-relevant condition families; map LINKED to association asserted and UNRESOLVED to association unresolved; never omit qualifying invoices solely for uncertain association.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One row per invoice that plausibly qualifies under purpose A universe (represented billed revenue with candidate contract exposure).

relations.name: purpose_b_required_link
relations.meaning: Pairwise counterparty identity links required by purpose B, labeled SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED per purpose epistemic policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from legal_entity_identity and counterparty_identifier for commercially relevant required pairs; epistemic copies disposition when confident, otherwise UNRESOLVED.
relations.construction_rule: C4: emit required links connecting CRM account, billed name, governing contract, and candidate registry entities for each commercially relevant relationship; sort by left then right for output.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Same pair universe as legal_entity_identity candidate_generation_rule filtered to commercially relevant relationships.

relations.name: purpose_c_commercial_dependency
relations.meaning: Purpose C dependency rows with counterparty identifier, contract, open invoices, obligation kinds, and dependent versus unresolved status under the conjunctive purpose definition.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from active_contract, invoice_open, invoice_contract_link, legal_entity_identity, and contract_term_reading for obligation kinds; status dependent only when both purpose conjuncts hold with confident joins.
relations.construction_rule: C4: for each counterparty-contract combination meeting or plausibly meeting dependency conjuncts, emit row; status dependent when (open invoice OR active auto-renew/rolling contract) AND qualifying obligation kind present with confident identity joins; otherwise unresolved; obligation_kinds as sorted subset of exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per (counterparty identifier, contract_id) where there is an open invoice or active continuing contract and at least one obligation-kind reading is PRESENT or UNRESOLVED.
